summary: Hawthorn Bancshares filed an 8-K on September 10, 2026 disclosing the death of director Jonathan "Jon" Holtaway, who passed away September 4, 2026, at age 55, after serving on the board since 2019 and also on Hawthorn Bank's board. The board seat becomes vacant; no successor, interim appointment, or committee reassignment was announced, and no advisor, terms, or transaction details were disclosed. Holtaway was president of Ategra Capital Management and managing member of Ategra GP, which manages Ategra Community Financial Institution Fund. Watch for a board replacement and any Ategra fund stake shift, plus governance continuity at the Nasdaq-listed bank.
